notes.title: New free-for-all game mode and maps
notes.notes:
The new amazingly fun free-for-all gameplay mode and maps are now complete and part of the game!

This new game mode features explosive 1v7 battles in two brand new maps designed specifically for this type of close quarter combat game mode. 

Here's a quick breakdown of the new major features available in this update:

[list]
[*] A new free-for-all game mode where players can battle against each other or against other bots

[*] Two new maps only available in this game mode

[*] Players can play online versus other players, or alone against other bots

[*] A new AI system designed for this type of game mode. The bots will look for players to battle on the map while also seeking powerups if low on health and ammo 

[*] Up to seven bots can be added to each match

[*] There are three selectable difficulty levels for the bots: Hard, Medium, and Easy

[*] Winner is selected at the end of each match based on the victory conditions selected at the beginning of the match. The victor is selected by either having the most kills, highest score, best kills to death ratio, or a combination of them all when the time expires

[*] A new scoreboard system available only in this game mode. It is displayed on the bottom right corner of the screen and it shows the player's up to date stats and leaderboard position.

[*] Matches can be replayed without reloading the mission

[*] There are three weapons available for selection for each class

[*] Only the Elite and Marine class are available for selection in this game mode. They all have jet packs and can travel by air or ground 
[/list]

This is the final major update before the game's official release in early Q1 2025.
There will probably be a couple more minor updates that will mostly focus on bug fixes and optimization of the game and loading time. There will also be some small added features, but all in all the game is now 95% complete. 

[b]So, go ahead and give this new version of the game a try and prepare to immerse yourself in loads of fun![/b]

notes.title: New Team Deathmatch 4v4 game mode and one new amazing map.
notes.notes:
New game mode and map now part of the full game experience!
It is a 4v4 deathmatch mode, an extraction type shooter, where you can play solo or online with up to seven other people.
The goal for the Alien team is to destroy the ship waiting for the Human team at the extraction point for departure. The Human team will be carrying important proof of this hidden bases' existence, so they must work together to get to the extraction point and escape with the ship waiting for their arrival. 
Just in type for Halloween, there are also monsters of all sizes and shapes that will attack both humans and Aliens in an attempt to stop them from completing their objectives,
There have also been many feature added as well as bug fixes.
The most those important features was the addition of spawn protection for when the player teleports or spawns into the mission. There is a five second countdown where the player is cloaked and invincible.

With this new map, the game now features a variety of environments, from beautiful lush forests and beaches to remote and cold locations. And all game modes can be played alone or online with other people!
If you like shooters, download and give this game a try. You can play the game online or offline in first or third person camera view. Also, you don't need to register if you choose not to. You can login as a guest user and just play the game. Registering your unique username is optional.
And there are now 12 unique maps in the game! 
With this amount of maps and game modes, there is sure something for almost everyone to enjoy.
Don't forget leave a positive review if you like the game. If you find any bugs, please report them in the forums or just send me an email.

Here are some screen shots and video of this new game mode in action,
Thank you and be ready for more new things to come very soon!

notes.title: NEW Multi-Player space combat map added!
notes.notes:
[b]It has finally arrived! NEW multiplayer combat in space and on foot inside three gigantic space ships![/b]
Battle in space or land inside these space cruisers and fight on foot.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40697684/17e9b3dcecf25a793ccea874c724e5a43883bda3.png[/img]

[b]This map can now be selected in the Multiplayer mode![/b] 
It was only available as a Single-player Campaign mission before.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40697684/1e753614f6a237f019fd66e00ad1d266b9f12c19.png[/img]

Play with or against your friends, or alone against AI. 
There are AI ships that act as wingmen or engage in a dogfight to prevent you from accomplishing your objectives.

 You can fight as the Humans in your quest to disable these space cruisers, or you can play as the Aliens to hold the Human team off until they run out of reinforcements.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40697684/3322df0dd7c080f4e1b39bf5fac0a7311d68b126.png[/img]

Either way you choose to play this map, [b]it promises to be a FUN time to remember[/b]!

ENJOY!

notes.title: New beautiful multi-player forest map, as well as many bug fixes and features.
notes.notes:
After a long eight months of development, the new beautiful multi-player forest map is now available in the game.
Many features and bug fixes have also been added.
Guest users can now play the game without registering, but their stats won't be tracked.
Multiplayer mini-maps have been improved so that the player can have a better view of what is happening on the map.
Teleport points are now available in the new multi-player forest map for faster travel between areas.
New ground vehicles, such as ATV-Quads, Ground Transport Vehicles, Tanks, Sci-Fi off-road vehicles, and Spider Mechs, can also be used for fast travel between different zones on the map.
New seat selection GUI is now available for each vehicle that has more than one seat.
New music and sounds have also been added to the new forest map.
Many major and minor bug fixes, as well as many other small features added throughout all the missions in the game.

notes.title: Major update: Multiplayer now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40697684/84015a4690d0ff3b257fe6e39283805e34b44748.png[/img]

Major Game Update Announcement:

[list]
[*] Peer-To-Peer [b]Multiplayer [/b]has been released and it is now included with this update! Anyone can now host or join a game in progress.
The multiplayer mode now includes a [b]Lobby[/b] where the host can choose to play the game alone against AI controlled bots, or can wait for up to 63 other players to join. The game can be played as cooperatively or as versus. Unruly players can now be banned or kicked from the game by the host. 
Games can also be password protected so that only people who know the password will be able to join.

There are 10 characters and well over 30 different weapons to choose from, such as: knives, pistols, guns, sniper guns, machine guns, gatling-gun, rocket launchers, various sci-fi weapons mines, C4's, grenades, just to name a few, all unique to the class they belong to. The two factions available to choose from in the Lobby are [b]Alien[/b] or [b]Human[/b]. Consequently, each faction has five classes: [b]Infantry[/b], [b]Assault[/b], [b]Heavy Assault[/b], [b]Elite[/b], and [b]Marine[/b].

The Marine and Elite classes are equipped with jet packs that can be used to traverse the map much faster. The Marine class is equipped with heavy jet packs and the Elite class are equipped with light jet packs. The heavy jet packs are slower, but use less energy and can be used to fly greater distances. As opposed to lighter jet packs which drain more energy and can be used to travel short distances very fast.

Flying vehicles can be mounted and unmounted by AI or non AI players and are equipped with blaster, laser, pulse weapons, as well as guided missiles and plasma bombs, just to name a few.

The current game mode included is called [b]Dominance[/b] where players must follow certain objectives to complete the mission. Objectives can vary from capturing areas controlled by the opposite factions to destroying various vehicles. The objectives can be viewed in game by pressing the [b]F2[/b] key on the keyboard. 

At the end of each mission, one of three stars (gold, silver, or bronze) is awarded to the players who best accomplish the criteria associated with that particular mission.
Points are also accumulated during the mission based on kills, deaths, and accomplished objectives.
The stats for each player can be viewed by pressing [b]F3[/b] on the keyboard.

To 10 best scores can be viewed at the end of each mission or by selecting the rankings option on the main menu.

A chat option between players in the Lobby and in the game has been also added. The in-game chat option can be activated by pressing the [b]F4[/b] key on the keyboard.

The game map can be viewed in the Lobby as well as in the game. The in-game map can be seen by pressing the [b]m[/b] key on the keyboard.

[*] A new authentication system has also been added, where players can now create an account from the main menu and then login with their unique username and password. This will ensure that each player's stats are accurately tracked every time they log into the game. There can only be one user name and password per e-mail address.

[*] Offscreen targets and objectives display have also been added.
Now there is a triangle shaped image displayed on the screen towards where the enemy is located outside the boundary of the field of view. 
Objectives are now displayed as pings on the player's screen and the right top corner radar. The direction towards the objective is displayed as a dark orange cone on the top right corner of the radar.

[*] Many minor and major bugs have also been fixed. This is the most stable release to date with great performance on new and old computers with a decent dedicated graphics card.
[/list]

Current owners of the game can now download this major update from their Steam account!

Enjoy and please leave a review or a comment in the forums if you enjoyed this game!

notes.title: V.F.C Multiplayer gameplay update
notes.notes:
Update: The Multiplayer feature is coming along very nicely. It is now finally in a working state. It has been a long and grueling road working on this every day for the past year.
It is currently being tested. Next step will be to add and test the feature with more maps.

It's taking longer than expected, as it has been a very difficult journey doing this on my own.
I was hoping it was going to take no longer than a year to have this working, but it hasn't panned out as I expected. I am confident that the game should be finished in the next six months at the most. In the meantime, you can check the new gameplay images posted from the game.
Any comments or suggestions are welcome. Will have more updates soon.
